extracted.intended_audience: researchers/applicants preparing proposals for NIH Director's High Risk–High Reward programs (Pioneer DP1, New Innovator DP2, Transformative R01, Early Independence DP5) and related emergency FOAs
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluative expectations for applications to NIH Director's High Risk–High Reward funding programs (Pioneer, New Innovator, Transformative Research, Early Independence), including emergency COVID-19 variants. Covers eligibility, desired qualities of projects and investigators, and program-specific submission expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator exceptional creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports individual scientists of exceptional creativity (Pioneer) / early stage investigators of exceptional creativity (New Innovator) / exceptional investigators for Early Independence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The programs seek investigators of "exceptional creativity" who propose pioneering, bold, or unconventional research. (Original phrasing: "supporting individual scientists of exceptional creativity"; "supports a small number of early stage investigators of exceptional creativity").

rubrics_metrics.name: Pioneering / substantially different scientific direction
rubrics_metrics.description: To be considered pioneering, the proposed research must reflect substantially different scientific directions from those already being pursued in the investigator’s research program or elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pioneer Award explicitly requires that proposed research be "pioneering and possibly transforming approaches" and that it be "substantially different scientific directions" from the investigator's current work or from work elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold, highly innovative research approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals should be bold and highly innovative new research approaches with potential to produce major impact on broad, important problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New Innovator: "bold and highly innovative new research approaches that have the potential to produce a major impact on broad, important problems in biomedical and behavioral research." Emphasize novelty and risk-taking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformative potential / unusually high impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Research must have the potential to produce an unusually high or major impact in a broad area of biomedical or behavioral research, including creating new scientific paradigms, establishing new/improved clinical approaches, or developing transformative technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transformative Research Awards: support "groundbreaking, exceptionally innovative, original and/or unconventional research with the potential to create new scientific paradigms, establish entirely new and improved clinical approaches, or develop transformative technologies."

rubrics_metrics.name: Little or no preliminary data expected
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants to Transformative Research Awards are not expected to provide extensive preliminary data; little or no preliminary data is acceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FOAs state explicitly: "Little or no preliminary data are expected." Applications should therefore focus on conceptual novelty and potential rather than extensive preliminary results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: early stage investigator for New Innovator
rubrics_metrics.description: New Innovator (DP2) solicits applications only from early stage investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program "supports a small number of early stage investigators of exceptional creativity..." Applicants should confirm early stage investigator status per NIH definitions and FOA instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: Early Independence (forgoing postdoctoral training)
rubrics_metrics.description: Early Independence Award (DP5) supports investigators who wish to pursue independent research directly after completion of their terminal doctoral/research degree or clinical residency, thereby forgoing the traditional post-doctoral training period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program aims to accelerate entry into an independent research career; applicants must be at the stage of completing a terminal degree or clinical residency and propose immediate independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for individuals or groups (team option)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transformative Research Awards can support individual scientists or groups of scientists proposing groundbreaking research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOA language: "supporting individual scientists or groups of scientists proposing groundbreaking...research" — teams are acceptable when the group collectively meets the program's high-risk/high-reward criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical trial optional designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Several FOAs are marked "Clinical Trial Optional," indicating that proposing a clinical trial is allowed but not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must follow FOA-specific instructions about clinical trial inclusion and clearly indicate clinical trial status if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: COVID-19 emergency FOA responsiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Two FOAs (Emergency Transformative Research R01 and Emergency Early Independence DP5) solicit applications responsive only to the COVID-19 public health emergency under the CARES Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These emergency FOAs restrict scope to CARES Act–funded COVID-19–responsive projects; all other Transformative Research or Early Independence applications must use the regular FOAs (RFA-RM-20-013 or RFA-RM-20-014).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to FOA-specific deadlines and program expiration
rubrics_metrics.description: Each program has specific application deadlines and an expiration date; applications must be submitted by the stated deadline (local time of applicant organization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists deadlines (e.g., Pioneer: Sept 11, 2020; New Innovator: Aug 21, 2020; Transformative R01: Sept 30, 2020; Early Independence: Sept 4, 2020) and notes program expiration dates. Applicants must follow the FOA's timeline and submission instructions.
